title: The Glasshouse of Anderlecht
author: Juniper Lockridge
blurb: Jonah Eastwick, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
